contentList.content: You have become a true thespian. Your <LSTag Tooltip="Charisma">Charisma</LSTag> increases by [1]. Your <LSTag Tooltip="ProficiencyBonus">Proficiency Bonus</LSTag> is doubled for Deception, Performance, and Persuasion <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityCheck">Checks</LSTag>. You have <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on Deception and Performance <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityCheck">Checks</LSTag>

Your Charisma increases by 1.

Gain Expertise in Deception, Persuasion, and Performance Checks. Additionally, you have Advantage on Deception and Performance Checks
You gain a bonus to Initiative equal to your <LSTag Tooltip="ProficiencyBonus">Proficiency Bonus</LSTag> and can't be <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SURPRISED">Surprised</LSTag>.

Your Intelligence or Wisdom increases by 1.

You gain a bonus to Initiative equal to your Proficiency Bonus, you gain Proficiency in Perception, and you can't be Surprised.Additionally, gain Proficiency in Insight, Investigation, or Perception.

Your Strength or Dexterity increases by 1.

When you are Prone, standing up uses significantly less movement. Your Jump distance also increases by 50%.

Let your speed intensify your onslaught. You can <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Rush_Charger_Push">Shove</LSTag> or gain a +[1] bonuns to an <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Rush_Charger_Attack>Attack Roll</LSTag>.
When you <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_Dash">Dash</LSTag>, your <LSTag Tooltip="MovementSpeed">movement speed</LSTag> is increased by [1].

Charge forward and Shove the first enemy in your way. Your chances depend on your Athletics, and are higher if you're <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SNEAKING">hidden</LSTag> or <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="INVISIBLE">invisible</LSTag>.
The shove distance depends on your <LSTag Tooltip="Strength">Strength</LSTag> and the target's weight.
Charge forward and slam your weapon into the first enemy in your way, you gain a +[1] bonus to this <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag>.

Your Strength or Dexterity increases by 1.

When you Dash you gain additional movement speed. Additionally, you gain Charger: Weapon Attack and Charger: Shove.
You gain <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> with all crossbows and your <LSTag Tooltip="Dexterity">Dexterity</LSTag> increased by [1]
When you hit a creature with a crossbow, you possibly inflict <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="GAPING_WOUND">Gaping Wounds</LSTag>.

Your Dexterity increases by 1.

You gain Proficiency with all crossbows.

When you make crossbow attacks within melee range, the Attack Rolls do not have Disadvantage.

Gaping Wounds.

Your Dexterity increases by 1.

When attacked while wielding a Finesse Weapon you're Proficient with, you can use a reaction to add your Proficiency Bonus to your Armour Class, possibly causing the attack to miss.

Your Strength or Dexterity increases by 1.

You can use Two-Weapon Fighting even if your weapons aren't Light. You cannot dual-wield Two-Handed weapons.
You have <LSTag Tooltip="Expertise">Expertise</LSTag> in Sleight of Hand and Perception <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityCheck">Checks</LSTag>.

Your Dexterity or Wisdom increases by 1.

You gain Advantage on Perception Checks made to detect hidden objects and on Saving Throws made to avoid or resist traps.

You gain Resistance to the damage dealt by traps.

Gain Expertise in Sleight of Hand and Perception Checks.

Whenever you are healed, you restore the maximum number of possible <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">hit points</LSTag>. You have <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on Death <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag>. Your <LSTag Tooltip="Constitution">Constitution</LSTag> score is increased by 1.

Your Constitution increases by 1.

You restore the maximum number of possible hit points when healed. You have Advantage on Death Saving Throws.

>Your Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma increases by 1.

Your spells and attacks ignore Resistance to a damage type of your choice. When you deal damage of that type, you cannot roll a 1.
When attacking with a melee weapon you are <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficient</LSTag> with and are wielding in both hands, you can cause the weapon to deal an additional [1].

Your Strength increases by 1.

When you land a Critical Hit or kill a target with a melee weapon attack, you can make another melee weapon attack as a bonus action that turn.

Attacks with melee weapons you are Proficient with, and are wielding in both hands, you deal additional damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Your <LSTag Tooltip="Strength">Strength</LSTag> increases by 1 and you gain <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourProficiency">Armour Proficiency</LSTag> with Heavy Armour.
You have <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourProficiency">Armour Proficiency</LSTag> with Heavy Armour and your <LSTag Tooltip="Strength">Strength</LSTag> increases by 1.
While wearing Heavy Armour, incoming Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage is reduced by [1].

Your Strength or Constitution is increased by 1.

While wearing Heavy Armor, incoming Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage is reduced by an amount equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

Your <LSTag Tooltip="Strength">Strength</LSTag> or <LSTag Tooltip="Dexterity">Dexterity</LSTag> increases by 1 and you gain <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourProficiency">Armour Proficiency</LSTag> with Light Armour and shields.
You have <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourProficiency">Armour Proficiency</LSTag> with Light Armour and shields.

Increase one Ability Score by 1.

You gain 3Luck Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus, which you can use to gain Advantage on Attack Rolls, Ability Checks, or Saving Throws, or to make an enemy reroll their Attack Rolls.
If you fail an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throw</LSTag>, you can cause yourself to succeed instead.
Choose to suceed on a failed Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throw</LSTag>.

Your Strength or Dexterity increases by 1.

Enemies you hit have Disadvantage on Concentration Saving Throws

Once per Short Rest, if you fail an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma Saving Throw, you can cause yourself to succeed instead.

You learn 2 cantrips, a Level 1 spell from the bard spell list, and gain a Level 1 spell slot. All spells use your normal spellcasting ability and you cannot upcast the 1st-level spell learned.

Your Charisma increases by 1.

You have learned 2 <LSTag Tooltip="Cantrip">cantrips</LSTag> and a Level 1 spell from the cleric spell list, and gained a Level 1 <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">spell slot</LSTag>. Your <LSTag Tooltip="Wisdom">Wisdom</LSTag> score is increased by 1.

You have learned 2 <LSTag Tooltip="Cantrip">cantrips</LSTag> and a Level 1 spell from the druid spell list, and gained a Level 1 <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">spell slot</LSTag>. Your <LSTag Tooltip="Wisdom">Wisdom</LSTag> score is increased by 1.

>Your <LSTag Tooltip="Strength">Strength</LSTag> or <LSTag Tooltip="Dexterity">Dexterity</LSTag> increases by 1 and you gain <LSTag Tooltip="WeaponProficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> with Martial Weapons.

Your Strength or Dexterity increases by 1.

When you wear Medium Armour, the bonus to Armour Class you can gain from your Dexterity Modifier becomes +3 instead of +2.

When you wear Medium Armour, the bonus to <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourClass">Armour Class</LSTag> you can gain from your Dexterity <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">Modifier</LSTag> becomes +[1] instead of +[2].
Enemies have <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="OpportunityAttack">Opportunity Attacks</LSTag> against you.
Your <LSTag Tooltip="MovementSpeed">movement speed</LSTag> increases by [1] and your <LSTag Tooltip="Dexterity">Dexterity</LSTag> is increased by 1.

Your Dexterity increases by 1.

Your movement speed increases, and difficult terrain doesn't slow you down when you Dash.

Opportunity Attacks have Disadvantage against you.
You have <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourProficiency">Armour Proficiency</LSTag> with Medium Armour.

Your <LSTag Tooltip="Strength">Strength</LSTag> or <LSTag Tooltip="Dexterity">Dexterity</LSTag> increases by 1 and you gain <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourProficiency">Armour Proficiency</LSTag> with Medium Armour.
Make an <LSTag Tooltip="OpportunityAttack">Opportunity Attack</LSTag> whenever a creature enters your reach.
Prerequisite: Must be wielding a glaive, halberd, quarterstaff, or spear.
When attacking with a glaive, halberd, pike, quarterstaff, or spear you can use a bonus action to attack with the butt of your weapon and deal [1].
Sweep your polearm around, whacking a foe with the weapon's heavy haft.

Your Strength or Dexterity increases by 1.

When attacking with a glaive, halberd, pike, quarterstaff, or spear, you can use a bonus action to attack with the butt of your weapon.

You can also make an Opportunity Attack when a target comes within range.
You increase an <LSTag Tooltip="Abilities">Ability</LSTag> by 1 and gain <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> in that Ability's <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag>.

Entity's next <LSTag Tooltip="RitualSpell">ritual spells</LSTag> will be cast without expending a <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">spell slot</LSTag>.

Your Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma increases by 1.

You learn 6 ritual spells of your choice.

Once per Long Rest, you can cast a ritual spell in combat without expending a spell slot.

Your Strength or Dexterity increases by 1.

When making melee weapon attacks, you roll your damage dice twice and use the highest result.
When making a weapon attacks, you roll your damage dice twice and use the highest result.
When a creature within range takes the <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_Disengage">Disengage</LSTag> action, you may make an opportunity attack against them.

Your Strength or Dexterity increases by 1.

When an enemy within melee range takes the Disengage action or attacks an ally, you can use a reaction to make a weapon attack against that enemy. Target ally must not have the Sentinel Feat.

You gain Advantage on Opportunity Attacks, and when you hit a creature with an Opportunity Attack, it can no longer move for the rest of its turn.

Your Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma increases by 1.

You gain Advantage on Saving Throws to maintain Concentration on a spell.

You can also use a reaction to cast Shocking Grasp at a target moving out of melee range.
